verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows permission controls for agents and apps, not people: admins can scope each agent's board access and audit its actions (monday-docs-10), and apps can request granular API scopes such as `boards:read` (monday-docs-6). Nothing documents roles or view/edit permissions for human team members on boards or items. Missing for 10: user/team role definitions, board- or item-level view vs. edit permissions for people, permission management controls usable by a product manager, independent corroboration.
